note: City specs of the Cities hub. Add a city = add one entry (or one row in tools/cities_catalogue.mjs); the generator and the tests need nothing else.

cities.name: Trades City
cities.motto: Every trade is a tower, month by month.

cities.name: Sessions City
cities.motto: One tower for every trading day, a street for every week.

cities.name: Levels City
cities.motto: Every swept high and low gets its own district.

cities.name: Hours City
cities.motto: A clock of districts: see which hours pay.

cities.name: Weekdays City
cities.motto: Five avenues, one per weekday, 631 trades deep.

cities.name: Months City
cities.motto: A calendar you can fly over: a tower per month.

cities.name: Risk City
cities.motto: The wider the stop, the taller the tower: size follows risk.

cities.name: Setups City
cities.motto: Districts by how the trade ended: target, stop, break-even.

cities.name: Accounts City
cities.motto: Real, paper and backtest accounts side by side.

cities.name: Sizing City
cities.motto: More micros, taller towers: how big each trade was.

cities.name: Streaks City
cities.motto: Winning and losing runs spiral out from the centre.

cities.name: Drawdown Canyon
cities.motto: Plateaus at the peaks, a canyon wherever the account fell.

cities.name: Equity Mountains
cities.motto: The account curve as a mountain range, 2021 to now.

cities.name: Ideas City
cities.motto: Thirty thousand tested ideas, each a building.

cities.name: Honesty City
cities.motto: Gold, green, amber, grey: how honest each idea is.

cities.name: Triggers City
cities.motto: A district for every trigger: sweeps, breaks, gaps, displacements.

cities.name: VIX City
cities.motto: The same ideas, sorted by how scared the market was.

cities.name: Daphne City
cities.motto: The idea trees grown into forests of towers.

cities.name: Forge City
cities.motto: Every bred strategy version stands where it was born.

cities.name: Gods City
cities.motto: Eight gods, thirty-four world states, one ring of temples.

cities.name: Feeds City
cities.motto: Every data feed a tower: fresh ones glow.

cities.name: Evals City
cities.motto: Four hundred simulated evals: the passes light up.

cities.name: Speed City
cities.motto: How many sessions an eval needs to pass, bot by bot.

cities.name: Arena City
cities.motto: Every XP event of the Arena, grouped by kind.

cities.name: Library City
cities.motto: Athena's entries on shelves: the taller, the longer.

cities.name: Workshop City
cities.motto: Tested settings stand tall, rejected ideas lie as ruins.

cities.name: Plans City
cities.motto: Prop-firm plans by period: what each would pay a month.

cities.name: Kalshi Bets City
cities.motto: Each bet the bot made, by asset: wins glow, losses burn.

cities.name: Obsidian City
cities.motto: Your notes as a city: folders are districts, links make them glow.
